contains-duplicate.title: Brute force
contains-duplicate.algorithm: Two nested loops; return true if any pair is equal.

contains-duplicate.title: Sorting
contains-duplicate.description: After sorting, duplicates sit next to each other.
contains-duplicate.algorithm: Sort a copy, then scan adjacent elements.

contains-duplicate.title: Hash set
contains-duplicate.description: Remember what you have already seen.
contains-duplicate.algorithm: Insert each value into a Set; if it is already present, a duplicate exists.

valid-anagram.title: Sorting
valid-anagram.description: Anagrams are identical after sorting their characters.

valid-anagram.title: Frequency count
valid-anagram.description: Count characters of s up, then count t down.
valid-anagram.algorithm: Use a 26-slot array (or a hash map for Unicode); all counts must end at zero.

two-sum.title: Brute force
two-sum.algorithm: Two nested loops checking nums[i] + nums[j] === target.

two-sum.title: Sorting + two pointers
two-sum.description: Sort (value, index) pairs, then move two pointers inward.
two-sum.algorithm: Keep original indices; move left up when the sum is too small, right down when too large.

two-sum.title: Hash map (one pass)
two-sum.description: For each value, look up its complement.
two-sum.algorithm: Store value -> index. For each x, check whether target - x was seen before storing x.

group-anagrams.title: Sorted string as key
group-anagrams.description: Anagrams share the same sorted form.
group-anagrams.algorithm: Group words in a map keyed by their sorted characters.

group-anagrams.title: Character-count key
group-anagrams.description: Avoid sorting by keying on letter counts.
group-anagrams.algorithm: Build a 26-count signature per word and use it as the map key.

top-k-frequent-elements.title: Sort by frequency
top-k-frequent-elements.description: Count, then sort distinct values by count.
top-k-frequent-elements.algorithm: Hash map of counts, sort entries descending, take k.

top-k-frequent-elements.title: Bucket sort
top-k-frequent-elements.description: A value's frequency is at most n, so use frequency as a bucket index.
top-k-frequent-elements.algorithm: buckets[f] holds values with frequency f; read buckets from high to low until k values are collected.

binary-search.title: Linear scan
binary-search.algorithm: Loop until the target is found.

binary-search.title: Iterative binary search
binary-search.description: Halve the search range each step because the array is sorted.
binary-search.algorithm: Maintain lo/hi, compare the middle element, discard the half that cannot contain the target.

linked-list-cycle.title: Hash set of visited nodes
linked-list-cycle.description: If you reach a node twice, there is a cycle.
linked-list-cycle.algorithm: Walk the list, storing nodes in a Set.

linked-list-cycle.title: Floyd's tortoise and hare
linked-list-cycle.description: A fast pointer eventually laps a slow pointer inside a cycle.
linked-list-cycle.algorithm: Move slow by 1 and fast by 2; they meet iff a cycle exists.

reverse-linked-list.title: Iterative pointer reversal
reverse-linked-list.description: Flip each next pointer while walking forward.
reverse-linked-list.algorithm: Keep prev/curr; save curr.next, point curr.next at prev, advance.

reverse-linked-list.title: Recursion
reverse-linked-list.description: Reverse the rest of the list, then attach the head at the end.
reverse-linked-list.algorithm: Recurse to the tail; on the way back set head.next.next = head.

climbing-stairs.title: Plain recursion
Bottom-up DP with two variables
climbing-stairs.description: Only the previous two values are ever needed.
climbing-stairs.algorithm: Iterate from 3 to n keeping the last two counts.

maximum-subarray.title: Brute force
maximum-subarray.description: Compute the sum of every subarray.
maximum-subarray.algorithm: For every start, extend the end and track the best sum.

maximum-subarray.title: Kadane's algorithm
maximum-subarray.description: Drop the running sum when it becomes a liability.
maximum-subarray.algorithm: cur = max(x, cur + x); best = max(best, cur).

longest-substring-without-repeating-char.title: Check every substring
longest-substring-without-repeating-char.algorithm: For each start, extend until a repeat appears.

longest-substring-without-repeating-char.title: Sliding window with last-seen index
longest-substring-without-repeating-char.description: Jump the left edge past the previous occurrence of a repeated character.
longest-substring-without-repeating-char.algorithm: Map char -> last index; left = max(left, last[c] + 1).

valid-palindrome.title: Clean then reverse
valid-palindrome.description: Normalise the string and compare it with its reverse.
valid-palindrome.algorithm: Lowercase, strip non-alphanumerics, compare with reversed copy.

valid-palindrome.title: Two pointers
valid-palindrome.description: Compare from both ends, skipping non-alphanumerics.
valid-palindrome.algorithm: Move l and r inward, skipping characters that are not letters or digits.
